race.comment: DIAMOND VIRTUE (1) didn't set the world on fire on debut at Ballarat when 5th over 1200m, beaten 4.5 lengths but can only be better for that. In good hands and can be expected to improve up in trip from a good draw. LAKE MORAINE (10) is another first-starter drawn wide, but is in good hands and progressing well at the trials. I BELIEVE I BELONG (8) wasn't far off maiden success before a break of six months, finishing the campaign with a minor placing over 2007m at this track. Has trialled two times leading into this and looks a key player. ALI SPINKS (3) son of Inference from My Thriller on debut. Filled a minor placing in his most recent trial. Worth watching for any major market moves.
